title: Rift weaver loom
mechanism: a 3x3 wooden-and-obsidian loom frame where floating shuttles weave threads of violet light into a vertical tear in the air, inputs are ender pearls fed into a brass hopper on the left and amethyst shards on the right, the finished rift shard drops into a crystal cradle at the front

title: Pylon rift gate
mechanism: four separate rune-carved stone pylons placed around a 5x5 floor, each pylon beams light to a central levitating ring that opens a starry void portal, a brass control lectern at the edge with a gem socket as the input

title: Void anchor drill
mechanism: a tall bone-white tower that lowers a rotating obsidian spike into a circular rift in the floor, void matter rises in a glass column on the side and collects in a lead-lined cask

title: Dimensional tuning fork
mechanism: a giant brass tuning fork on a stone base, struck by a mechanical hammer driven by a Create-style shaft, each strike makes a ring of light that opens a small rift above, input tray of gems at the base

title: Quantum altar
mechanism: a stepped octagonal altar of blackstone and white ceramic, items placed on six small pedestals float up and spiral into a central glass sphere where they dissolve into cyan light, a single crafted item appears on the top plate, thin steel conduits connect it to a tech power port at the back

title: Clockwork arcane altar
mechanism: a round oak altar with brass clockwork gears turning under a glass floor, a central rotating gem focuses purple beams on items on the pedestals, a crank on the side

title: Mana condenser altar
mechanism: an altar where liquid mana drips from hanging brass flasks into a carved stone basin, items dipped in the basin glow and transform, glass pipe input from the back

title: Ritual pillar chain
mechanism: a variable-size ring of separate standing stones with glowing glyphs, each stone links to the next with a beam of light, the ring encloses a carved floor circle where a sacrifice chest and an output brazier sit, can be built with 4 to 12 stones

title: Lantern ward circle
mechanism: a circle of hanging iron lanterns on wooden posts, each lantern burns a different coloured flame, flames stretch toward a central cauldron that brews a glowing essence

title: Totem resonance array
mechanism: several carved totem poles placed apart, each topped with a different gem, vibration rings pass between them and charge a floating crystal in the middle, input and output via a brass chest at the foot of one totem

title: Arcane assembly line
mechanism: a conveyor belt of riveted steel runs through three stations, the first a Create-style press, the second a brass gem lens that bathes the part in purple light, the third an enchanting circle that seals it, the inputs are visibly a steel plate and a source gem, the output is a glowing rune-engraved plate

title: Mana-steam boiler
mechanism: a copper boiler where a magic flame of blue fire heats the water instead of coal, glowing glyphs on the firebox, steam goes into a brass pipe to a Create-style engine, input slot shaped like a gem socket

title: Essence centrifuge
mechanism: a steel centrifuge with glass vials on spinning arms, the vials hold glowing coloured essences separated from mob drops, motes of light escape as it spins, input hopper on top, rack of filled vials as the output

title: Runic circuit etcher
mechanism: a clean steel workbench with a laser head that etches glowing runes into circuit boards, an amethyst lens focuses the beam, input stack of blank circuit boards and gem dust, output tray of glowing runic circuits

title: Crystal growth vat
mechanism: a glass vat filled with luminous liquid where a big amethyst crystal grows on a brass armature, small crystals are harvested by a mechanical arm into a chest

title: Starlight collector
mechanism: a large brass parabolic dish with a gem at the focus, aimed at the sky, collected starlight runs down a glass tube as glowing liquid into a tank at the base

title: Soul forge
mechanism: a dark iron forge with a ghostly teal fire, wisps of souls drift in from a cage of captured mobs, a hammer animated by spectral hands strikes ingots on an anvil
